declared_differences.description: Shear deformation: SWBPIPE's frame preview is Euler-Bernoulli; a Timoshenko formulation adds shear flexibility. Predicted difference = Timoshenko - Euler-Bernoulli hand value with kappa = 0.5 (ASSUMPTION: CAEPIPE's shear formulation is not documented in the admitted sources).

fault_injection.description: elastic modulus in the MBF MATERIAL rows multiplied by 1.10 after writing; deliberate fault to show the loop catches and classifies a real difference
